from numpy import array

def verif(ch):
    test=True
    #Lettres alpha maj
    i=0
    while test==True and i<len(ch):
        if not ("A"<=ch[i]<="Z"):
            test=False
        i=i+1 
    #Lettres Distincts
    for i in range(len(ch)-1):
        for j in range(i+1,len(ch)):
            if ch[i]==ch[j]:
                test=False
                
    #Long CH
    if not (5<=len(ch)<=10):
        test=False
    
    return test

def saisir():
    cle=input("Donner la Clé! : ")
    while not(verif(cle)):
        cle=input("Donner la Clé! : ")
    return cle

def cryptage(ch,cle):
    ch=ch[:len(ch)-1]
    #Ajout d'espace si necessaire
    while len(ch) % len(cle)!=0:
        ch=ch+" "
    
    #Distrubtion dans la matrice
    C=len(cle)
    L=len(ch)//C
    M=array([[str()]*C]*L)
    k=0
    for i in range(L):
        for j in range(C):
            M[i,j]=ch[k]
            k=k+1

    #Formation de la ligne cryptée 
    R=""
    for j in range(C):
        R=R+cle[j]
        for i in range(L):
            R=R+M[i,j]
    return R

def remplir(cle):
    FS=open("Source.txt","r")
    FC=open("Crypte.txt","w")
    ch=FS.readline()
    while ch!="":
        FC.write(cryptage(ch,cle)+"\n")
        ch=FS.readline()
    FC.close()
    FS.close()
    return FC
     
def afficher(FC):
    FC=open("Crypte.txt","r")
    ch=FC.readline()
    while ch!="":
        ch=ch[0:len(ch)-1] #Pour supprimer le \n
        print(ch)
        ch=FC.readline()
    FC.close()
